description: Opening/early-middlegame pattern detector (ply <= ~15) built from specific bottom cells: fires when I have a stone at the bottom of column 2 and the opponent holds the bottom of columns 1 and 5, or holds a column-3 stack (their stones at rows 1 and 3 of column 3 around mine). Also fires on the 1-ply opening in column 1. An opponent stone at the bottom of column 6, or mine at the bottom of column 5, suppresses it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every column's probability by at most about 0.04.
notes: Hypotheses: (0,1)+(0,5) bottom pattern; column-3 tower; weighted cell template. Dev F1: 0.11 -> 0.35 (ply gate) -> 0.41 -> 0.44 best (P 0.42, R 0.47, AUROC 0.72), sim share 0.07. Minimal pairs confirm the cell effects but they interact non-additively and the last-move order matters a lot, so this looks like a distributed early-game template, possibly a random direction. Synthesis 7.12 beats dev max 7.03.
